Imatra Talousneuvola's 2026 schedule was found but the page did not explicitly state the fee.
Free emergency accommodation is available through Tilma in Lappeenranta and the 24/7 Etelä-Karjala shelter in Imatra; both are regional services, not duplicated locally.

Lappeenrannan seurakuntien free community meals operate at several recurring locations. Tikankulma also reports surplus-food distribution on Mondays and Thursdays, but its exact time, eligibility and fee status are unpublished.
